    Request pipeline (project ShiftPlanner.Api)

    Middleware in the order it is registered; each request passes through it top to bottom.

    1. UseSwagger
    2. UseSwaggerUI
    3. GlobalExceptionMiddleware (UseMiddleware)
    4. UseHsts
    5. UseCors
    6. UseRateLimiter
    7. UseAuthentication
    8. UseAuthorization
